people.name: Cabul
people.line: Name given to 20 cities by Hiram

translations.web: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.
translations.bsb: “What are these towns you have given me, my brother?” asked Hiram, and he called them the Land of Cabul, as they are called to this day.
translations.kjv: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
translations.asv: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
